# Optical module provenance

The displacement-field generator and `MaterialFilterContents` are copied without changes from:

- Repository: https://github.com/lucaperullo/simple-liquid-glass
- Fixed revision: `9f1ca87d360d9a1c79a1f0e318ab804156c8f9c1`
- Source files: `src/vendor/samasante/displacement.ts`, `src/vendor/samasante/MaterialFilter.tsx`
- Optical modules: Copyright (c) 2026 Sam Asante, MIT; see `LICENSE.samasante`.
- Library: Copyright (c) 2025 lucaperullo, MIT; see `LICENSE`.

The surrounding React lifecycle, pointer feedback, navigation selection indicator, CSS appearance, and fallback are authored locally for Gala X Ci. No library animation loop, scene capture, or WebGL copy renderer is bundled. SVG backdrop refraction is enabled only in Chromium; other engines receive the explicit CSS fallback.
